tags.text: I came by Land Rover. With a woman who swears. [pause] Hello.
I'm wet. I'm alive. I'm wet and alive. [pause] It's over.
You were talking to yourself about me?
I seem to have lost a blazer. Navy. Brass buttons. Very sad about it.
Film the sea. It's very interesting at the moment. Trust me.
Vasco would say they're fine examples of the human form. Vasco would be right.
I'm teasing. [pause] Will we be here for it?
Derek. The best thing in the building is behind that rope down there. The mummies. They never let anyone film them.
That's dangerous. That tastes like a good decision.
She saw me come in. In last night's shirt. The eyebrow saw too.
[pause] Oh, no. [pause] Oh, Alan.
Thank you, Nieves. It's had a big night.
I. [pause] The discs. Montesdeoca. I thought—
On the waist of the bell: an S between two little bells. [pause] Our mark. The Sanches mark. Here. In 1751. Before Lisbon. Before any of it.
In the nets, something round and orange with rust. A helmet. A conquistador's helmet, in a fishing net.
Is he all right?
Vasco read the lock. He's the best in the world at it. Which means it's coming for him too.
Where's Vasco?
I'm an idiot. I've been an idiot all week. It was Baute, not Montesdeoca, and Vasco's up there, and nobody's heard from him since yesterday. Please.
Are you hurt?
I slept with someone. A painter. Twenty-three. I lied to him about Vasco. And I didn't tell Vasco first. I didn't tell anyone first. I didn't tell anyone anything. That's my whole personality.
I'm sorry.
That's it. That's all of it. I lied to him, and I didn't tell you first, and I'm telling you now.
A shoebox. 'E.' on the lid in marker. Everything left of a woman fits in a shoebox. It never seems right.
Me. Asleep. In charcoal. He drew me while I slept. [pause] I look about twenty-five and completely at peace. I'm neither.
It's here. [pause] It's come for me.
It can't be. We put it back. It's a thousand kilometres from Lisbon.
I don't want to look at it. It's looking at me. It knows what I did last night. It doesn't care, which is worse.
Carmen. [pause] My feet are wet. There's water in the footwell. Salt. It's rising.
Black water round my ankles. It knows me. I can feel it knowing me.
I'm in it to my waist. It's cold. It's patient. It's very, very patient.
It's him. Montesdeoca. 'Twenty-third, at dawn.' He's going to do something on San Juan—
'The discs go down to the lower vault at night. Only Rayco has the key.' [pause] Not Montesdeoca. Baute. It was Baute all along, and the clue was a metre from my elbow while I was busy lying.
That's not fair.
